summary: Iteration 7: regression test of the refactor that should not change behaviour, plus the QR print XSS fix. Backend: all 56 pytest tests pass. That is 49 existing tests plus the new test_refactor_it7.py with 7 tests: unit tests for _due_marker, _service_due_day and _reminder_text, GET /api/maintenance/alerts due/detail, service item in GET /api/calendar/events, and daily + eve cron -> cron_runs gets kind/date/sent>=1, duplicate run_id, 401 on a wrong token. Frontend (Playwright, desktop plus mobile 390px), all passed. (1) QR print popup: h1 = brand+model, .plate, ' and plate 'TEST-XSS1' everything renders as literal text: 0 img, 0 b, no alert or dialog. (2) PhotoCapture: upload shows the preview, remove brings back the picker, open camera -> headless fake camera stream became ready (so camera-error not shown; error path not exercised), Cancel returns to the picker, re-upload works. (3) SignaturePad: 'Sign here' / 'Hier unterschreiben' placeholder; submitting without a signature shows the 'Signature required' toast; after drawing the placeholder is hidden, Clear restores it, and submit works. (4) PDF: DE and EN for a handover+return pair (notes, extras, both signatures) and DE for a UI-created pair download without JS errors. Content checked: labels, rows, wrapped notes, [x]/[ ] extras, footer, embedded images. (5) Handover: vehicle select prefills mileage and extras; custom extra added; duplicate ignored and input cleared; submit 200. Return from history: mileage and extras prefilled, submit 200. (6) Calendar 'Start protocol': handover prefills vehicle, driver and mileage and shows the handover-from-calendar banner; after save the event shows Done and the start button is gone. Return auto-opens the dialog with the return-from-calendar banner and is marked done after save. on_road and no-open-handover toasts each appear exactly once. (7) Mobile /handover/: extras list, custom add with duplicate ignored, submit 200, success screen. (8) ExtrasEditor in vehicle edit: add, Enter with a duplicate is ignored, remove. (9) Calendar: 4 day clicks in the same month send 0 new GET /calendar/events requests; next month and week next each send 1 request with the correct range; Today; add appointment with date prefilled, conflict warning, remind checkbox unchecked -> saved remind_day_before=false with the 'double-booked' toast and conflict marker; edit keeps remind unchecked; .ics href; delete with confirm; subscribe dialog feed URL. Drag & drop is now pointer-accurate (the iteration-6 24px bug is fixed): week cell 14 -> 14:30, cell 9 lower part -> 09:30, 'none' row -> time removed, month cell lower part -> that day (not the next week), month upper part OK. (10) App shell: logo -> dashboard, settings language DE/EN + theme light/dark, alerts badge '1 due' with a due schedule, footer 'FleetPro v1.7', all 5 tabs plus Drivers and Service lists load. No page errors or console errors in any run.

ui_bugs.issue: Bug that already existed before the refactor: form state resets (signature_base64 = '') but both SignaturePad canvases keep showing the old drawing and the 'Sign here' placeholder stays hidden. A second handover then fails with 'Signature required' although a signature is visible. Fix: remount the pads after submit (e.g. key={resetCounter}) or expose a clear() ref.
Bug that already existed: pressing Enter in the 'Add custom item' input does nothing (ProtocolsTab supports Enter). The input and its add button also have no data-testid.

issues: Active sub-tab 'Handover Protocol'/'Übergabeprotokoll' has text rgb(82,82,91) on bg rgb(37,99,235). Contrast is about 2:1 and the text is hard to read; the light-theme override should keep text-white on the active blue pill.
Switching the theme while the form is mounted leaves the canvas painted in the old theme (dark canvas in light mode) until reload, because the canvas is only painted on mount
Date and time fields use native <input type=date/time> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover (already existed)
When the vehicle has no extras, an empty bordered box is rendered (looks broken); show an 'no extras' hint or hide it

critical_code_review_comments: Small behaviour change: App useFleetData.refresh and the Drivers/Maintenance/Vehicles/Protocols load callbacks have [t] in their deps. Every language switch now refetches all lists and re-runs registerServiceWorker/ensureServiceWorker (confirmed: switching to DE fired /vehicles, /dashboard/stats, /maintenance/alerts, /drivers, /maintenance/*). Harmless but avoidable: split the SW registration into its own [] effect, or read t through useLatest.
Each tab fetches twice on mount in the preview (React.StrictMode dev double-effect). Expected in dev only, not a production issue.
key={e.name} on extras lists: protocols stored earlier with duplicate extra names would cause React duplicate-key warnings. New input now dedupes, but consider key={`${e.name}-${idx}`}.
useCalendarEvents uses the vehicles array as refreshKey, so every App refresh() (after any mutation) refetches calendar events; OK but implicit.
VehicleQRModal printQr: safe DOM construction verified. doc.title is set from user data, which is safe (title is text). If window.open is blocked, the click silently does nothing; consider a toast.
ProtocolsTab.jsx is still 742 lines (>700). Split HandoverForm and HistoryList into their own files.
server.py is about 1050 lines. Move the calendar/iCal/cron code into a router module.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested regression flows pass; 2 bugs that already existed and some design notes found

context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date 2026-11-04. Seed: python /app/backend/tests/ui_seed_it7.py (writes /tmp/it7_seed.json); 'cleanup' arg deletes the vehicles. QR print test: override window.open in the page to capture the popup window and stub w.print, then inspect popup.document. Headless Chromium provides a fake camera, so camera-error does not appear; to test the error path, override navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia to reject. Drags: mouse.down -> small move -> move(steps=15) -> check .bg-blue-600\/25 highlighted cell -> mouse.up. Drop now lands at the pointer.
rca of the issue: SignaturePad stale after submit: HandoverForm calls setForm(initialForm()) but SignaturePad keeps its own canvas and hasSignature state, and nothing resets or remounts it. Repro: complete a handover, then try a second one without re-signing -> 'Signature required' while the old signature is still visible. Mitigation: <SignaturePad key={formKey}/> with formKey incremented on success.
